earlyExit.intro: The review was not completed and the report is incomplete due to the following issues:

reasons.text: Source archive contains the built XPI

findings.message:
This add-on was submitted as a source-code archive, but the archive contains the built XPI in full: every file the XPI ships is in the archive byte for byte. A source-code archive holds the readable source of an XPI that was built (bundled, transpiled or otherwise transformed) and cannot be reviewed directly, not a copy of that XPI. If the XPI can be reviewed directly, submit just the XPI (which is reviewed considerably faster). If the add-on must be built, but the archive also includes the built XPI by mistake, please remove it.
Read more: https://webextension-api.thunderbird.net/en/mv3/guides/sourceCodeSubmission.html
